Gravel Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe)

Philadelphia, PA · Wissahickon / East Falls · Gravel

No-dropBeginner friendly

Gravel Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe) is a gravel group ride in Philadelphia, PA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from PAPERtrail Bike Cafe. About 17 miles, social, no-drop, regroup at the top of each climb.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social, no-drop, regroup at the top of each climb. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @papertrailbikecafe the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Gravel Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe) group ride

Seventeen miles, about 65 percent gravel, through the Wissahickon. Two notorious climbs but the group waits at the top of each. Espresso shots at the finish. Bring charged lights. Bike demos available for $30; parking and bag storage at the shop.
